name: Mini UPS
subtitle: Industrial - Other
description: A compact 12V UPS with dual output ports, user-replaceable batteries (19–38 Whr), up to 10 hours backup, and auto turn-on for keeping routers, cameras, and access points online during power cuts.

hardware.value: User replaceable (18650/26650), overcharge and discharge protection. Thermal protection
19 Whr, backup time 3-5 hours/ 38 Whr, backup time 9-10 hours
Charging and output power status indicators

use_cases.title: Router & Modem Power Backup
use_cases.desc: Provides backup power to routers and modems during mains power interruptions, keeping network connectivity active when it is needed most. This helps prevent communication downtime and ensures uninterrupted access to critical online services.

use_cases.title: CCTV & Security Continuity
use_cases.desc: Keeps CCTV cameras and security systems operational during power outages through reliable backup power support. This ensures continuous surveillance, uninterrupted video recording, and consistent protection of critical premises.

use_cases.title: Smart Device Power Resilience
use_cases.desc: Maintains power to connected smart devices during electrical interruptions, helping prevent unexpected shutdowns and communication loss. This ensures essential networked equipment remains operational and available for monitoring and control.
